evidence.title: AF-12 cooling hold
evidence.claim: In 2017, the cooling hold before the white spirit letdown was confirmed as still necessary to prevent vapour ignition.
evidence.quote: As long as we let down with white spirit (flash point about 39 °C) the batch must be below 40 °C

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-2001-012
evidence.claim: In 2001, a requirement to cool the batch below 40 °C before letdown was introduced following a flash fire.
evidence.quote: Reason: flash fire IR-2001-007 - letdown of white spirit (flash point approx. 38 °C) into a hot batch

evidence.title: INCIDENT REPORT IR-2001-007
evidence.claim: A flash fire occurred in June 2001 during white spirit letdown into a batch at 58 °C, causing operator burns.
evidence.quote: Event: flash fire at the open manhole during the white spirit letdown. Batch temperature at letdown 58 °C

evidence.title: INCIDENT REPORT IR-2001-007
evidence.claim: A flash fire occurred in 2001 because the batch temperature (58 °C) exceeded the white spirit flash point (38 °C).
evidence.quote: Root cause: white spirit flash point is about 38 °C; at 58 °C the batch was well above it
